name: Oceania Hotels
verdict: Breton hotel brand, published by SAS SOFIBRA, whose Président is F.B.I., a holding whose board is made up of Branellec family members; the brand calls itself a Breton family company founded in 1975. Nothing found.
note: Rating note: chain SOFIBRA → F.B.I. from the website's mentions légales and the company register; F.B.I.'s board lists only Branellec family members. No state or fund stake found → none.
